text: More than 65% of terrestrial nature has been shaped, in very different ways, by people.
Anthromes are defined as the ecological patterns shaped by human habitation.
Visualized here is the Anthromes Dataset. It is a "hindcast," a model built from global population and land use data showing change over 12,025 years.
As global population increases, and urbanization accelerates, biodiversity shrinks.
Preserving "cultured" and "wild" lands is key to preserving biodiversity.
